“好，我马上到！”陈青云挂断电话，立刻出门，心中难免有些蠢蠢欲动。这么晚了，宁轻眉突然喊他上门，难道是想……但他又摇了摇头，觉得一定是自己想多了，宁轻眉应该不是那种随便的人！“咚！咚！咚！”很快，他就来到了宁轻眉的公寓前，敲响了门。“砰！”下一刻，大门打开。只见宁轻眉穿着单薄的睡衣，浑身都湿透了，睡衣紧贴着身子，甚至能看到紫色蕾丝罩罩……“宁县长，你这是怎么了？”陈青云大吃一惊。“我刚才想要洗澡，结果水管爆掉了！”宁轻眉无奈解释，此刻的她少了白天的优雅端庄，反而显得有些狼狈。本来，她也不想麻烦陈青云。偏偏她才刚搬来，举目无亲，也没有物业和修理工的电话……再加上她身份特殊，不方便让闲杂人等上门，所以就想到了陈青云。“别担心，让我去看看！”陈青云立刻走进屋子，直奔浴室，只见水管肆意狂喷，地上都是积水。在一旁的衣篓里，还有一条巴掌大小的黑色内内，蕾丝半透明款，应该是宁轻眉刚才脱下来的……那岂不是说，现在她睡衣里是真空的？“宁县长，我先去把总闸关了！”陈青云很快去关掉总闸，然后又回来换上了新水管，大功告成。但他身上也都被水浇湿，白衬衫之下，八块轮廓分明腹肌清晰可见，散发着男性荷尔蒙。宁轻眉也忍不住多看了几眼，俏脸微微泛红，感激道：“谢谢你，否则我真不知道该怎么办！”“宁县长，为你效劳，这是我该做的！”陈青云谦虚道。“下班之后，就别喊我县长了！”宁轻眉说道。“好的，轻眉姐……”陈青云换了个称呼，只觉得两人的距离，似乎也拉近了一些。这时，他发现宁轻眉的睡衣完全被水浸湿，紧紧贴在娇躯上，非但勾勒出凹凸有致的身材，就连那雪峰都清晰可见。“真挺！”陈青云睁大了眼睛，忍不住在心中感叹。

她看着高挑纤细，其实身材惹火，非常有料！这时，宁轻眉也察觉到了他的目光，低头一看，顿时反应过来。她连忙拿起一件外套披在身上，但心脏却怦怦直跳，犹如小鹿乱撞般的慌乱。他看到了么？这下怎么办……真是羞死人了！一时间，屋内的气氛，变得有些尴尬。“青云，谢谢你帮忙，但时间不早了，你回去休息吧！”宁轻眉有些不敢面对他，只能下起了逐客令。“哦。”陈青云有些失落，迈开步子，朝着门外走去。但突然，他又停下脚步。见到这一幕，宁轻眉的心咯噔了一下。他要干什么？孤男寡女，共处一室，若是陈青云真的失去理智，那她恐怕真的无法反抗！但担心的同时，宁轻眉的内心深处，似乎又有些期待。她是正常的女人，有七情六欲，也渴望得到男人的呵护。但结婚多年，她却还保持着完璧之身，只因丈夫一向迷信，畏惧“白虎克夫”的传闻，始终没有碰过她……所以，她也有些好奇，不知男女之事究竟是什么滋味。“轻眉姐！”突然，陈青云扭头望着她，大着胆子问道：“上次我说过抓凤筋的事情，你考虑的怎么样了？如果今晚你不忙，那不如试试？”“这……”宁轻眉松了一口气，随后俏脸又微微泛红，开口问道：“你说的这种治疗，要多久才能起效？”“说立竿见影，那绝对是骗你的！不过一两个月，就能有明显的效果！”陈青云回答。“好，那就试试吧……”宁轻眉紧咬红唇，犹豫再三，最终还是点头。“这里不方便，我们去卧室吧！”陈青云提议道。宁轻眉也没拒绝，带着他走进了自己的闺房。面积不大，十几个平方，但胜在干净素雅，还弥漫着一股茉莉花的淡淡幽香。“轻眉姐，麻烦你背对着我，趴在床上！”陈青云说道。“嗯。”

"Okay, I'll be there soon!" Chen Qingyun hung up the phone and went out immediately, feeling a little anxious in his heart.It was so late, and Ning Qingmei suddenly called him to the door. Could it be that he wanted to... But he shook his head again, feeling that he must have thought too much. Ning Qingmei should not be the kind of casual person!"Boom! Boom! Boom!" Soon, he arrived at Ning Qingmei's apartment and knocked on the door."Bang!" The next moment, the door opened.I saw Ning Qingmei wearing thin pajamas. She was soaked all over. The pajamas clung to her body and she could even see the purple lace bra... "County Magistrate Ning, what's wrong with you?" Chen Qingyun was shocked."I wanted to take a shower just now, but the water pipe burst!" Ning Qingmei explained helplessly. At this moment, she lacked the elegance and dignity of the day, and instead looked a little embarrassed.Originally, she didn't want to trouble Chen Qingyun.But she had just moved here, had no relatives, and had no phone number of the property manager or the repairman... In addition, because of her special status, it was not convenient for people to come to her door, so she thought of Chen Qingyun."Don't worry, let me take a look!" Chen Qingyun immediately walked into the house and went straight to the bathroom. He saw the water pipe spraying wildly and the ground was covered with water.In the clothes basket on the side, there is also a palm-sized black panty, lace translucent style, which should be the one Ning Qingmei took off just now... Doesn't that mean that there is a vacuum in her pajamas now?"County Magistrate Ning, I'm going to turn off the main gate first!" Chen Qingyun quickly went to turn off the main gate, then came back and replaced the new water pipe, and you're done.But his body was also soaked with water. Under his white shirt, eight chiseled abdominal muscles were clearly visible, exuding male hormones.Ning Qingmei couldn't help but look at it a few more times, her pretty face flushed slightly, and she said gratefully: "Thank you, otherwise I really don't know what to do!" "County Magistrate Ning, this is what I should do to serve you!" Chen Qingyun said modestly."After get off work, don't call me county magistrate!" Ning Qingmei said."Okay, Sister Qingmei..." Chen Qingyun changed his name, and felt that the distance between the two seemed to be getting closer.At this time, he found that Ning Qingmei's pajamas were completely soaked with water and clung tightly to her delicate body. Not only did she outline her curvy figure, but even the snow-capped peaks were clearly visible."It's so cool!" Chen Qingyun opened his eyes wide and couldn't help but sigh in his heart.

She looks tall and slender, but she actually has a hot figure and is very attractive!At this time, Ning Qingmei also noticed his gaze, looked down and reacted immediately.She quickly picked up a coat and put it on her body, but her heart was pounding like a frightened deer.Did he see it?What to do now... I'm so embarrassed!For a moment, the atmosphere in the room became a little awkward."Qingyun, thank you for your help, but it's getting late. You should go back and rest!" Ning Qingmei was afraid to face him, so she could only issue an eviction order."Oh." Chen Qingyun was a little disappointed, took steps towards the door.But suddenly, he stopped again.Seeing this scene, Ning Qingmei's heart skipped a beat.What is he going to do?A man and a woman are alone in the same room. If Chen Qingyun really loses her mind, then she may not be able to resist!But while she was worried, Ning Qingmei seemed to have some expectations deep in her heart.She is a normal woman with all kinds of emotions and desires, and she also longs for a man's care.But after many years of marriage, she still maintained her perfect body. This was because her husband had always been superstitious and feared the rumors of the "white tiger's wife" and had never touched her... Therefore, she was also a little curious about what it was like to have sex between men and women."Sister Qingmei!" Suddenly, Chen Qingyun turned to look at her and boldly asked: "Last time I mentioned the matter of catching phoenix tendons, how did you think about it? If you are not busy tonight, why not give it a try?" "This..." Ning Qingmei breathed a sigh of relief, and then her pretty face turned slightly red again, and asked: "How long will it take for the treatment you mentioned to take effect?" "I would definitely lie to you if I said it would be effective immediately! It will only take a month or two to have obvious effects!" Chen Qingyun replied."Okay, let's give it a try..." Ning Qing frowned and bit her red lips, hesitated again and again, and finally nodded."It's not convenient here, let's go to the bedroom!" Chen Qingyun suggested.Ning Qingmei did not refuse and took him into her boudoir.The area is not large, more than a dozen square meters, but it is clean and elegant, and it is filled with the faint fragrance of jasmine."Sister Qingmei, please turn your back to me and lie on the bed!" Chen Qingyun said."Um."
